taskPreset.title: Saga
taskPreset.description: Create a long-running saga, then run it with an orchestrator that dispatches workers and records evidence.

panel.contextSectionDescription: The saga lives in this project's .hagicode/sagas folder.
panel.repositoryAccessHint: Optional. Mark the repositories the saga may change (write) or only read.
panel.sagaSectionDescription: create plans a saga from your input. run executes an existing saga.
panel.commandHint: create: plan only, nothing is executed. run: act as the orchestrator of an existing saga.
panel.sagaIdHint: create: a new id, or an existing id to add an amendment. run: required unless exactly one saga is open.
panel.objectiveHint: create: what the saga must achieve. If the saga already exists, this is the amendment to fold in.
panel.objectivePlaceholder: Describe the outcome, not the steps.
panel.constraintsHint: Scope, non-goals, safety rules, areas that must not change.
panel.workItemsHint: Items you already know about, one per line. The planner may refine them.
panel.verificationHint: How each item can be checked by a command: test commands, environment, expected output.
panel.referencesHint: Documents, paths or links the planner should read first.
panel.runOptionsHint: run only: parallelism, stop conditions, or extra instructions for the orchestrator.

groups.sagaDescription: Plan a saga, then run it.

create.description: Create a saga from your input, or fold the input into an existing saga as an amendment. Plans only.

run.description: Run a saga as its orchestrator: freeze the contract, dispatch workers, verify, and tick with evidence.
